title: Light and Sound Lab · Q4 W08 D04
objective: Describe how light and sound behave and identify safe ways to protect people.

items.explanation: A window is made of clear glass, so light passes through it. Wooden doors, metal boxes, and brick walls block light.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use sound?
items.explanation: A quiet voice is gentle on the ears, so it is a safe way to use sound indoors.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use light?

options.text: do not play with fire near paper
name a color in the room
count the books on a shelf

items.explanation: Fire near paper can start a dangerous blaze, so keeping them apart is a safe way to use light and heat.

items.prompt: Which example shows how sound behaves?

options.text: a lamp lights a dark room

items.explanation: The radio's speaker vibrates to make music, which is sound. Windows, mirrors, and lamps are about light.

items.prompt: Which example shows how light behaves?

options.text: a drum makes sound when struck
a whistle makes a high sound

items.explanation: Clear glass lets light pass through, so the room is bright. Radios, drums, and whistles make sound.
